title: Bell Flight Collective elevates customer connections
summary: Operators across the U.S. gathered together to showcase their aircraft.
body_markdown:
Earlier this month, Bell welcomed a group of customers and suppliers to Bentonville, Arkansas, for this year’s Bell Flight Collective, an annual multi-day gathering designed to bring operators, guests, suppliers and Bell team members together for time spent flying, collaboration, and relationship building.


During the event, approximately 20 customers and five suppliers met with the Bell team for dedicated meetings, technical discussions and networking.


Customers had the opportunity to fly in their own Bell aircraft, showcasing a diverse lineup of aircraft that included the Bell 206, Bell[407](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/407) , Bell[505](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/505) , and a Bell[429](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/429) .


While Bell[505](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/505) owners have previously come together for similar events, this year marked the first time private North American owners of the Bell 206, Bell[407](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/407) and Bell[505](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/505) gathered as one collective.


“This event is about connecting people who share a passion for flying and Bell products and giving them direct access to our teams and suppliers,” said Lane Evans, managing director, North America.


“When these groups of individuals come together, we gain invaluable feedback that shapes how we support operators and evolve products for the future.”


With multiple aircraft on site, participants were able to share best practices, talk about mission profiles, and explore how they leverage Bell’s commercial solutions in their daily operations.


Safety was also a central theme, with discussions focused on enhancing operational safety and pilot proficiency. In addition to flight activities, attendees were able to connect through meetings and discussions with key suppliers and Bell representatives.


By creating a dedicated space for collaboration and open dialogue, the Bell Flight Collective highlighted Bell’s commitment to supporting customers and building long-lasting relationships across its customer base.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Bell.*
